definition: UNIQUE (Oddity, First Light): at most one Unique card in your Line. First Light is one per game.
does: Makes a second Unique card unplayable for you.
does_not: Does not limit your hand. Does not stop the opponent playing theirs.

contrast.sealed: Unique limits how many you play; Sealed is the owner's hold.
contrast.wild: Unique limits the count; Wild is the ability.
